description: Path map for tools/port_upstream.py. 'moved' maps each whole-file move into mower_sdk/legacy/ from its upstream path to its path here; a patch touching the upstream path is rewritten to the new one. 'mixed' names the core files whose content was split by extraction (MowerMQTT into legacy/mqtt_v1.py, the Thing* classes into legacy/thing_models.py, MowerAuthError and COMMAND_ERRORS into legacy/errors.py): a series touching any of them is refused for manual classification.
